analysis.narrative:
📊 **Consensus:** Bearish with medium conviction - structural headwinds (regulatory tightening, real rate pressure, retail participation collapse) outweigh bullish technology narratives, creating a grinding consolidation with downside bias.

📈 **Themes:** (1) Bifurcated market: AI/tech innovation momentum versus broader demand weakness and valuation compression from higher real rates, (2) Regulatory uncertainty across crypto and financial infrastructure creating execution risk for bullish thesis, (3) Elevated event-driven volatility in tactical windows as structural macro forces prevent sustained directional conviction.

🎯 **Levels:** SPY ($691.66): Call Wall $750 (56k OI), Put Wall $630 (149k OI). Max Pain $693. Near support: $670 (81k OI, active), $640 (101k OI). Near resistance: $730 (48k OI). QQQ ($621.26): Call Wall $650 (28k OI, active hedging), Put Wall $574.78 (116k OI). Max Pain $625. Near resistance: $630 (27k OI, active), $640 (26k OI, active). Near support: $590 (80k OI), $580 (108k OI).
